page.layout: One page of running text, one column. Running head at the top centre. Below the last line, at the right, the catchword. A curly brace stands in the left margin beside the lines from "obtestor" to "turbatus", with no text in it. No page number is printed.

main_text.p: cogatur & subiacere: sub quo, idolomanico iugo premi, superstitione & hoc Satanico Patu occæcari,in bello turpiter quouis leuissimo hostiū appulsa cadere mereatur. Quam tamen stante & florente religione, occidente & emarcescente Papismo, nec manus Dei magnopere afflixit, nec hominum externa uis, uel oppugnare ausa est: uel si oppugnarit, expugnare non potuit. Hæc cum dolore dico, Reuerendissimi Patres eoç[?] magis,quod causam harum plagarum, uerbi diuini contemptum & Romanarum sordium illuuiem esse interpretor:quod Christo profligato,Papam hunc totius mundi fascinum & Circen,non seruum seruorum, sed dominum omnium dominorum,non Christi uicarium,sed diaboli ministrum,nostro capiti & ceruicibus insultare maluerimus, quam Christi suauc[?] iugū, onus leue,iucundissimā crucem exosculari. Et hæc apud uos hoc tempore queror, sanctissimi uiri :ut præsentem hanc calamitatem,non leuem causam, quæ me ad hoc incitaret, fuisse intelligatis: utcunque per uiscera misericordiæ in Christo Iesu uos obtestor,ut quod facitis,pergatis facere: pro Anglia,quæ pro se orare non potest,orare uelitis:quo Papa hic ex animis Christianorum, Italorum,Hispanorum,Gallorum,Anglorū, omnium exemptus, è regnis & Ecclesijs deturbatus, rumpatur medius, & pereat. O-rate,

page.notes: The first word is a large initial letter, read as "c" (cogatur). The Greek abbreviation after "eo" is doubtful: read as eoç[?]. "suauc" is uncertain, possibly suauem, and is marked [?]. The lines from "Papam hunc" to "Et hæc apud uos hoc" are underlined in the print; the underlining is not italic, so it is not marked in the text. The curly brace in the left margin is a printed bracket, not a note, and carries no text. No page number is visible. The catchword "rate," is taken from the foot, as it stands below the last full line.
